name: Gad
bio: Gad was a prophet, later known as "David's seer." While David had brought his parents to Mizpah in Moab for safety and was himself hiding in a stronghold, the prophet Gad told him, "Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah," and David obeyed, going to the forest of Hereth (1 Samuel 22:5). Gad went on to play an important role throughout David's life as one who conveyed the LORD's word to him, a story that continues through the rest of 1 and 2 Samuel.
